visual.title: The r in r dr dθ
visual.caption: In polar coordinates equal steps in r and θ do not sweep equal areas. Cells near the origin are small, which is exactly what the factor r accounts for.

predict.question: In polar coordinates the area element dx dy becomes:
predict.explain: The Jacobian of (r, θ) is r, so dx dy = r dr dθ. The quarter disk area is π/4.
